title: Canadian Curry Chicken-Free Delight
description: A flavorful vegetarian alternative to traditional chicken curry, featuring zesty ingredients and a Canadian twist.
instructions: In a large pan, sauté grated zucchini and carrots in a little oil until tender.
Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in shredded cheese curds until melted and well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and top with chopped green onions.
Bake in the preheated oven for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
